description: Create multiple groups in a single bulk request.

groups.description: Group definitions to create. Each dictionary should use canonical Sisense group fields, at minimum ``name``.

examples.user_query: Create multiple groups for the new project team: 'Data Analysts', 'Project Managers', and 'QA Engineers'.
examples.notes: This call creates three new groups in bulk for organizing users in the new project team.

examples.user_query: Can you bulk-create groups for 'Marketing Leads' and 'Sales Executives'?
examples.notes: Use this call to quickly create multiple groups for department-specific roles.

examples.user_query: I need to set up groups for 'HR Admins', 'Finance Team', and 'IT Support'.
examples.notes: This example demonstrates creating groups for different organizational functions in one request.

group_id.description: The ID of the group to delete.

examples.notes: This call deletes the group identified by 'group_12345' from the Sisense server. Use this when you need to remove a group permanently.

examples.user_query: How do I remove a group with the ID 'marketing_team'?
examples.notes: This example demonstrates how to delete a group named 'marketing_team'. Use this when you want to clean up unused or obsolete groups.

examples.user_query: Can you delete the group identified as 'archived_group_001'?
examples.notes: This call removes the group 'archived_group_001'. This is useful for managing archived or deprecated groups in your system.

description: Retrieve groups — one named group, or all of them.

name.description: Group name to filter by. Omit for all groups.

examples.user_query: Retrieve all groups from the Sisense server.
examples.notes: This call fetches the complete list of groups defined on the Sisense server. Useful for auditing or managing group memberships.

examples.user_query: What are all the groups currently defined in Sisense?
examples.notes: This call retrieves all groups, which can be used to review existing group configurations or permissions.

examples.user_query: List all groups available on the Sisense server.
examples.notes: Use this call to get a comprehensive list of groups for administrative purposes or integration tasks.

description: Retrieve group memberships — one group's members, or every membership.

group_name.description: The name of the group whose members to list. Omit for all memberships. A name that matches no group returns ``{"error": "..."}`` naming it — never a silent empty list. Naming ``Everyone`` or ``All users in system`` returns their members — an explicit request is always honored, even though the all-groups view omits them.

examples.user_query: List the members of the 'Data Analysts' group.
examples.notes: This call retrieves all users belonging to the 'Data Analysts' group. Use it to audit group membership or fetch user details for further processing.

examples.user_query: List all users in the 'Executive Team' group.
examples.notes: Use this call to fetch the members of the 'Executive Team' group, which might include high-level stakeholders or decision-makers.

examples.user_query: Get the list of users in the 'Marketing Specialists' group.
examples.notes: This call is helpful for identifying members of the 'Marketing Specialists' group, enabling targeted communication or permissions management.
